Running: Remove unused Docker images
audit: erun doctor --dry-run --prune-images team dev
trace-log: would append the full trace to <TMP>
==> Doctor team/dev
helm status team-devops --namespace team-dev --kube-context test-context
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev get pods -o wide
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -lc '<remote-script>'
git-push-access-script:
  set -eu
  cd '<TMP>' 2>/dev/null || { printf 'remote=\n'; exit 0; }
  remote=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true)
  printf 'remote=%s\n' "$remote"
  if [ -z "$remote" ]; then exit 0; fi
  case "$remote" in
    https://*|http://*) host=$(printf '%s' "$remote" | sed -E 's#^[a-z]+://([^/]+)/.*#\1#') ;;
    git@*) host=$(printf '%s' "$remote" | sed -E 's#^git@([^:]+):.*#\1#') ;;
    ssh://*) host=$(printf '%s' "$remote" | sed -E 's#^ssh://([^/@]+@)?([^/]+)/.*#\2#') ;;
    *) host="" ;;
  esac
  fetch_ok=0
  if git ls-remote --exit-code "$remote" HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then fetch_ok=1; fi
  printf 'fetch_ok=%s\n' "$fetch_ok"
  gh_auth=0
  if [ -n "$host" ] && command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh auth status -h "$host" >/dev/null 2>&1; then gh_auth=1; fi
  printf 'gh_authenticated=%s\n' "$gh_auth"
  push_credential=0
  if [ "$gh_auth" -eq 1 ]; then push_credential=1; fi
  if [ "$push_credential" -eq 0 ] && { [ -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ] || [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; }; then push_credential=1; fi
  if [ "$push_credential" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$host" ]; then
    case "$remote" in
      git@*|ssh://*)
        if ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -T "git@$host" 2>&1 | grep -qi "successfully authenticated"; then push_credential=1; fi
        ;;
    esac
  fi
  printf 'push_credential=%s\n' "$push_credential"
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev wait --for=condition=Available --timeout 2m0s deployment/team-devops
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec -c erun-dind deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -lc '<remote-script>'
doctor-inspect:
  set -eu
  printf '== Disk usage (/var/lib/docker) ==\n'
  df -h /var/lib/docker
  printf '\n== Inode usage (/var/lib/docker) ==\n'
  df -i /var/lib/docker
  printf '\n== Docker system df ==\n'
  docker system df
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev wait --for=condition=Available --timeout 2m0s deployment/team-devops
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec -c erun-dind deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -lc '<remote-script>'
doctor-prune_images:
  set -eu
  docker image prune -a -f
  docker system df
==> Doctor done team/dev
